stats.name: Body
stats.about: Strength, stamina, swimming, and holding your ground.

stats.name: Mind
stats.about: Memory, education, deduction, and knowing things.

stats.name: Nerve
stats.about: Courage, self-control, and keeping your voice steady.

stats.name: Sense
stats.about: Perception, reflexes, and reading a room or a shore.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.about: Running, climbing, swimming, and moving over rough ground.

skills.name: Brawl
skills.about: Fighting with fists, boots, or a heavy hand.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.about: Getting clear of a blow, a net, or a falling stone.

skills.name: Boat
skills.about: Handling a skiff, rowing against tide, or holding a line.

skills.name: Listen
skills.about: Hearing voices, bells, or wet footsteps in the dark.

skills.name: Look
skills.about: Noticing details, reading weather, and spotting lies.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.about: Treating wounds, judging death, and knowing what the body has suffered.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.about: Moving quietly, hiding, and avoiding notice.

skills.name: Talk
skills.about: Questioning, calming, threatening, or lying without flinching.

skills.name: Lore
skills.about: Knowing old stories, church secrets, and local superstition.

skills.name: Resolve
skills.about: Fighting off fear, nausea, and what you have seen.

table.name: Slip
table.effect: Drop something small, or make a sound that carries.

table.name: Freeze
table.effect: You are Frozen until you spend an action.

surge.effect: A Flawless: on an attack the weapon counts twice; otherwise choose one bonus.
options: Do it in half the time.
Learn a secret about the place.
An ally gains +10 on their next roll.

strain.name: Sanity
strain.atMax: Breakdown: you are Shaken until you rest, and Sanity drops to 3.

defence.note: Difficulty to hit a character = base + Sense + armour's defence bonus.

actions.name: Guard
actions.does: Add +10 to your defence until your next turn.

actions.name: Flee
actions.does: Move away; an attacker may follow after a Dodge versus Athletics check.

actions.name: Aid
actions.does: Make Talk or Medicine to remove a condition from an adjacent ally.

conditions.name: Shaken
conditions.ends: A rest, or an ally steadies you (Regular Peril Resolve).

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.effect: -10 on every roll; lose 1 Health each round unless tended.
conditions.ends: Medicine Hard Peril, or a long rest.

conditions.name: Frozen
conditions.effect: You cannot act except to steady yourself.
conditions.ends: You spend an action to steady yourself (Routine Peril Resolve).

rest.short: Recover half your Health; clear 2 Sanity.
rest.long: Recover all Health; clear all Sanity and conditions.

advancement.perLevel: Gain 10 Truth; spend it to raise skills. Every 3rd Standing may raise one stat (max 20).

rulings.a: One rolls; each helper adds +10, to a maximum of +20.

rulings.q: What happens when Sanity is at 3 or 5?
rulings.a: At 3 Sanity you roll at -10; at 5 Sanity you roll at -20. At 0 Sanity you Break Down and become Shaken until you rest.
A Mistake marks 1 Sanity. On a failed roll, extra consequences may apply; on any roll, 96-00 is treated as a Mistake.
